entities.name: Shree Digvijay Cement Green Energy Private Limited

industry: Commodities > Construction Materials > Cement & Cement Products

operating_notes.text: Commenced purchase and distribution of Hi-Bond cement under BDA effective March 19, 2026.
Cement manufacturing capacity doubled to 3.0 million tons per annum starting October 1st, 2025, via a new grinding plant at Sikka.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹208.47 Cr (-3.7% YoY), net profit ₹7.94 Cr (-56.8% YoY).
Shree Digvijay Cement reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹208.47 Cr and EBITDA of ₹25.10 Cr, driven by higher realizations.
Shree Digvijay Cement reported that the appointment process for a new CEO and MD is ongoing.
Q2FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹161.35 Cr, net profit ₹10.22 Cr.

India Resurgence Asset Management Business Private Limited’s promoters—India Resurgence Fund - Scheme 1, Scheme 2, and Scheme 4—declare no encumbrances on Shree Digvijay Cement Co. Ltd. shares for FY2026, signed by MAHESHCHAND KOTHARI.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at the Annual General Meeting
Statutory and regulatory approvals for promoter stake sale to India Resurgence Fund
Statutory and regulatory approvals for Hi-Bond Cement distribution and option agreement
